versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the send-to-me skill, a tool for sending messages to WeCom (企业微信) users, departments, or tags.
- Supports message sending via CLI and Python function calls, with flexible configuration through command-line arguments, environment variables, or .env files.
- Enables specifying message sender and receivers (touser/toparty/totag); includes default templates for various notification types and custom formatting via MessageFormatter.
- Comprehensive documentation for setup, configuration, and usage included.
